title: Indigenous groups oppose Milei plan to open Argentina to foreign buyers
english: Indigenous communities in Argentina are protesting a new government proposal that seeks to lift restrictions on foreign ownership of rural land. While President Javier Milei’s administration claims this measure will boost the economy and secure property rights, opponents argue it puts their ancestral territories at risk. Many people recently gathered in Buenos Aires to voice their concerns over the potential loss of their traditional lands to international buyers.
amharic: በአርጀንቲና የሚገኙ ተወላጅ ቡድኖች መንግስት በገጠር መሬት ላይ የውጭ ዜጎች ባለቤትነት እንዲኖር የሚፈቅድ ህግ ለማፅደቅ ማቀዱን በመቃወም ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። የፕሬዝዳንት ሀቪየር ሚሌይ አስተዳደር ይህ እርምጃ ኢንቨስትመንትን ይስባል ብሎ ቢያምንም፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን የቀድሞ አባቶቻቸው የወረሱት መሬት አደጋ ላይ እንደሚወድቅ ይገልጻሉ። በዚህ ረገድ ቡድኖቹ መሬታቸው ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች የመሸጥ ስጋት እንዳለው በመግለጽ በቦነስ አይረስ ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Hawaasni biyyoolessaa Arjantiinaa keessa jiraatan, mootummaan lafa baadiyyaa biyyattii irratti abbummaan gurgurtaa ormaaf akka banamuuf karoora qabate mormaa jiru. Mootummaan Prezidaant Javier Milei tarkaanfiin kun invastimantii guddisuuf gargaara jedhee amanus, mormitoonni garuu lafti sanyii isaanii irratti argamu kun gurguramuun qe'ee isaanii irraa isaan buqqisuu danda'a jedhanii yaadu. Namoonni hedduun karoora kana mormuuf magaalaa Buunos Ayiresitti walga'ii mormii taasisaniiru.

title: Ben-Gvir mocks Palestinian detainee over prison conditions
english: Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has published a video in which he ridicules a Palestinian woman being held in an Israeli detention center. The footage highlights the harsh living conditions of those in custody, although the specific reasons for her arrest remain unknown. Currently, thousands of Palestinians are being detained by Israeli authorities without any formal charges.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር በእስራኤል ማረፊያ ቤት የምትገኝ አንዲት ፍልስጤማዊት ሴትን ሲሳለቁ የሚያሳይ ቪዲዮ ይፋ አድርገዋል። ቪዲዮው በእስር ቤት ውስጥ ያለውን አስከፊ የመኖር ሁኔታ የሚያሳይ ቢሆንም፣ ሴትዮዋ ለምን እንደታሰሩ በግልጽ አልታወቀም። በአሁኑ ጊዜ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ያለምንም ክስ በእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ታስረው ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ministeerri Israa'eel Itamaar Ben-Gviir dubartii Paalastayinii mana hidhaa Israa'eel keessa jirtu tokko irratti qoosuun viidiyoo gadhiiseera. Viidiyoon kun haala jireenyaa hamaa hidhamtootaa kan mul'isu yoo ta'u, sababni hidhaa dubartittii garuu ifa miti. Yeroo ammaa kana Paalastayinonni kumaan lakkaa'aman himannaa tokko malee qabamanii hidhaa Israa'eel keessa jiru.

title: From Sudan to Spain: Between war and home | Al Jazeera Originals
english: Aboubaker, a young Sudanese man, traveled through five countries and the Sahara Desert to seek a new life in Spain. While he has successfully integrated into his new community in Madrid through work and sports, his life remains overshadowed by the ongoing conflict in Sudan. He now faces the emotional struggle of trying to build a future while worrying about the safety of his family back home in Darfur.
amharic: አቡበከር የተባለ ወጣት ሱዳናዊ በተሻለ ህይወት ፍለጋ አምስት ሀገራትን እና የሰሃራ በረሃን አቋርጦ ወደ ስፔን ተሰዷል። በማድሪድ ከተማ በስራ እና በስፖርት አዲስ ህይወት መመስረት ቢችልም፣ በሱዳን የተቀሰቀሰው ጦርነት ግን የሰላሙን ህይወት አወኩት። በአሁኑ ወቅት አቡበከር በአዲሱ መኖሪያው ህይወቱን ለመገንባት እየጣረ፣ በዳርፉር ከሚገኙ ቤተሰቦቹ ስለሚሰማው የጦርነት ወሬ ስጋት ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Abubakar jedhamu dargaggeessi Sudaan tokko jireenya gaarii barbaacha biyyoota shan fi gammoojjii Sahaaraa qaxxaamuree gara Ispeen godaaneera. Magaala Maadriid keessatti hojii fi ispoortiin jireenya haaraa jalqabuu kan danda'e yoo ta'u, garuu waraanni Sudaan keessatti ka'e nagaa isaa waraaneera. Amma abubakar biyya isaa keessatti jireenya isaa ijaaruuf yaalaas, maatiin isaa Darfuur keessatti argaman sodaa waraanaa keessa jiruuf yaaddoo guddaa qaba.

title: Israeli soldiers jailed over Sde Teiman walkout
english: Fourteen Israeli soldiers were sentenced to military prison for staging an unauthorized protest at the Sde Teiman detention base. This disciplinary action stands in stark contrast to the handling of a separate sexual abuse case at the same facility, where soldiers faced no consequences and were allowed to return to duty. The incident has drawn attention to the differing legal standards applied to soldiers within the Israeli military justice system.
amharic: አስራ አራት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በስዴ ቲማን እስር ቤት ፈቃድ የሌለው ተቃውሞ በማድረጋቸው ወደ ወታደራዊ እስር ቤት እንዲገቡ ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ይህ የቅጣት እርምጃ በተመሳሳይ እስር ቤት ውስጥ በጾታዊ ጥቃት የተጠረጠሩ ወታደሮች ክስ ተቋርጦላቸው ወደ ስራቸው መመለሳቸው ጋር ሲነጻጸር ትልቅ ልዩነትን ያሳያል። ይህ ክስተት በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ የፍትህ ስርዓት ውስጥ ለተመሳሳይ ወታደሮች ስለሚሰጡ የተለያዩ የህግ አያያዞች ጥያቄ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el kudha afur ta'an, buufata Sde Teiman keessatti ajaja malee hiriira waan ba'aniif gara mana hidhaatti akka galan murteeffameera. Murtii kun, waraana buufata sana keessatti saalaan wal-qunnamtii dirqisiisuun himataman kanneen himannaan irraa kaafamee gara hojii isaaniitti deebi'an wajjin yoo madaalamu garaagarummaa guddaa qaba. Taateen kun seera raayyaa ittisa biyyattii keessatti waraana irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatamu garaagarummaa qabaachuu isaa ifa godheera.

title: FIFA boss Infantino’s position looks unacceptable: European Leagues head
english: European Leagues president Claudius Schafer has criticized FIFA leader Gianni Infantino for attempting to sell World Cup commercial rights without proper approval. This secretive plan faced intense backlash, leading major football organizations to lose faith in Infantino’s leadership. Schafer argued that Infantino's focus on maximizing profits at the expense of national leagues and his unilateral decision-making make his continued presidency untenable.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ሊጎች ፕሬዝዳንት ክላውዲየስ ሻፈር የፊፋው ፕሬዝዳንት  Gianni Infantino ያለ ተገቢ ፈቃድ የዓለም ዋንጫን የንግድ መብቶች ለመሸጥ በመሞከራቸው በጽኑ ተችተዋል። ይህ ምስጢራዊ ዕቅድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ የገጠመው ሲሆን፣ ይህም ዋና ዋና የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት በInfantino አመራር ላይ ያላቸውን እምነት እንዲያጡ አድርጓል። ሻፈር እንደተናገሩት፣ የፕሬዝዳንቱ በብሔራዊ ሊጎች ላይ ጉዳት በማድረስ ትርፍ ላይ ብቻ ማተኮር እና በራሳቸው ብቻ መወሰን ቦታቸውን የማይመጥን አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pireezidantiin Liigota Awurooppaa Klaawudiyees Shaafar, geggeessaan FIFA Gianni Infantino hayyama sirrii malee mirga daldala Waancaa Addunyaa gurguruuf yaalii gochuusaanii balaaleffataniiru. Karoorri dhoksaan kun mormii cimaa kan mudate yoo ta'u, kunis dhaabbilee kubbaa miillaa gurguddoo hoggansa Infantino irratti amanannaa akka dhaban godheera. Shaafar akka jedhanitti, Infantino dantaa mataasaanii qofa irratti xiyyeeffachuufi murtoo ofii qofaan fudhachuunsaanii akka isaan hoggansa kanaaf hin malleefi.

title: Five dead, 41 missing, after Indonesia ferry catches fire
english: A passenger ferry traveling from Surabaya to Makassar caught fire off the coast of Madura island, Indonesia. While rescue teams managed to save many of the 250 people on board, five individuals have been confirmed dead. Currently, authorities are actively searching for 41 passengers who remain missing.
amharic: ከሱራባያ ወደ ማካሳር ሲጓዝ የነበረ የኢንዶኔዥያ የባህር መርከብ ማዱራ ደሴት አቅራቢያ በእሳት ተያያዘ። በመርከቧ ላይ ከነበሩት 250 ሰዎች መካከል ብዙዎቹ በአዳኝ ቡድኖች ቢተርፉም፣ የአምስት ሰዎች ህይወት ማለፉ ተረጋግጧል። በአሁኑ ወቅት የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች የጠፉትን 41 መንገደኞች ፍለጋ ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Markabii imaltootaa magaalaa Suraabayaa irraa gara Maakaasaar deemaa ture ganda Maaduuraa biratti ibiddaan manca'eera. Namoota markabicha keessa turan 250 keessaa baay'een isaanii lubbuun oorfamus, namoonni shanan du'aniiru. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, humnoonni gargaarsaa namoota 41 bakka buutee hin beekamne barbaacha irratti argamu.

title: Residents of Spain’s Ceuta shut down far-right anti-migrant rally
english: In the Spanish territory of Ceuta, a large group of local residents successfully prevented a far-right protest against migrants from taking place. The demonstrators organized their counter-protest to show opposition to the anti-migrant message following a recent surge in border crossings from Morocco. Due to the intense public pushback, the original organizers were forced to call off their event.
amharic: በስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ የሚኖሩ በርካታ ነዋሪዎች፣ ስደተኞችን በመቃወም ሊካሄድ የነበረውን የቀኝ አክራሪዎች ሰልፍ አግደዋል። የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች ከሞሮኮ ድንበር አቋርጠው በመጡ ስደተኞች ምክንያት በተፈጠረው ውጥረት ውስጥ፣ ፀረ-ስደተኛ እንቅስቃሴውን በመቃወም ተቃውሟቸውን አሰምተዋል። በነዋሪዎቹ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ሳቢያ፣ የሰልፉ አዘጋጆች ዝግጅቱን ለመሰረዝ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Naannoo biyya Ispeen kan ta'e Si'uutaa keessatti, jiraattonni baay'een ta'uudhaan hiriira garee mirga-duraa (far-right) kan godaantota irratti xiyyeefate dhaabaniiru. Jiraattonni kun, erga godaantonnii biyya Morookoo irraa gara daangaa sanaa dhufuu isaanii booda kan ka'e mormii akkasii mormuuf walitti qabamaniiru. Dhiibbaa uummataatiin kan ka'e, qindeessitoonni hiriira sanaa guyyaa sana osoo hin geggeessin haquuf dirqamaniiru.

title: A quiet day in Harare after Zimbabwe’s shutdown call
english: Harare experienced a quiet day as citizens responded to a nationwide strike protesting controversial constitutional amendments that extend presidential terms and change how leaders are elected. Authorities maintained a heavy security presence, including police blockades and water cannons, to prevent potential demonstrations against the new laws. While some shops remained closed, the city stayed calm as residents reacted to the changes that allow President Mnangagwa to remain in power longer.
amharic: የዚምባብዌ ፕሬዝዳንት የስልጣን ዘመን እንዲራዘም የሚያደርገውን አወዛጋቢ የህገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ በመቃወም በተጠራው አድማ ምክንያት የሀገሪቱ ዋና ከተማ ሃራሬ ዛሬ ረጋ ብላ ውላለች። መንግስት ሊፈጠሩ የሚችሉ ተቃውሞዎችን ለመቆጣጠር በከተማዋ ከፍተኛ የፖሊስ እና የፀጥታ ሀይል አሰማርቷል። አንዳንድ የንግድ ቤቶች ዝግ ቢሆኑም፣ በከተማዋ ሰላማዊ ሁኔታ ታይቷል፤ ለውጦቹም የፕሬዝዳንት ኤመርሰን ምናንጋግዋን የስልጣን ዘመን እስከ 2030 እንዲራዘም የሚያደርጉ ናቸው።
oromo: Magaalaan Harare kan Zimbabwe, jijjiirama seera bu'uuraa mootummaa kan pirezidaantii hanga bara 2030 aangoo irra turuu dandeessisu mormuuf waamicha dhaabbiin hojii taasifameen guyyaa har'aa cal'istee oolte. Mootummaan agarsiisa mormii ittisuuf poolisoota hedduu fi meeshaalee tasgabbii magaalaatti bobbaaseera. Bakkeewwan tokko tokkotti duukaantonnii fi iddoonni hojii cufaa ta'anis, magaalattiin tasgabbii qabdi; jijjiiramni kunis aangoo pirezidaant Emmerson Mnangagwa dheeressuu fi sirna filannoo jijjiiruu isaa kan mormitootaan balaaleffatamuudha.

title: Why has Trump halted Iran attacks, and what is the deal he is hinting at?
english: President Donald Trump has paused military strikes against Iran, claiming that regional leaders requested a delay while a potential agreement is finalized. Trump insists this deal must include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and the total abandonment of Iran’s nuclear program. However, Iranian officials have officially denied requesting any such delay, labeling Trump's statements as false while maintaining that their military forces remain prepared for conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ሊወስዱ የነበረውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ለጊዜው ማገዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ትራምፕ ይህን ውሳኔ ያሳለፉት የክልሉ ሀገራት ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ጊዜ እንዲሰጣቸው በመጠየቃቸው ነው ብለዋል። ሆኖም ኢራን እንዲህ ያለ ጥያቄ እንዳቀረበች የሚገልጸውን የትራምፕ ንግግር ውድቅ ያደረገች ሲሆን፣ ወታደሮቿ ለማንኛውም ጥቃት ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaanald Tiraamp tarkaanfii waraanaa Iraan irratti fudhachuu turan yeroof dhaabuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, hogganoonni naannichaa waliigaltee irra gahuuf yeroo akka isaan barbaachisu gaafachuu isaaniitiin tarkaanfii kana dhaabuuf murteessaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, qondaaltonni Iraan gaaffii akkanaa dhiyeessuu isaanii haaluun, ibsi Tiraamp soba ta'uu fi waraanni isaanii haleellaa kamifuu qophii ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Trump 'cancels' Iran strikes as Israeli attacks on Gaza continue
english: President Trump has paused planned military strikes against Iran after being asked for time to negotiate a new nuclear agreement and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. This decision follows a missile attack by Iran on a U.S. base in Jordan and pressure from regional leaders, including the Saudi Crown Prince, to pursue diplomacy. Meanwhile, Israeli military operations in Gaza persist, with recent airstrikes resulting in further Palestinian casualties.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በአዲስ የኑክሌር ስምምነት እና የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን ለመክፈት ድርድር ለማድረግ ጊዜ እንዲሰጣቸው በመጠየቁ በኢራን ላይ ሊወስዱት የነበረውን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት አዘግይተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ኢራን በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአሜሪካ የጦር ሰፈር ላይ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ከሰነዘረች በኋላ እና የሳውዲ ልዑል አልጋ ወራሽ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ እንዲፈለግ ጥሪ ካቀረቡ በኋላ የተወሰደ ነው። በሌላ በኩል በእስራኤል እና በጋዛ መካከል ያለው ግጭት የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ በእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት የፍልስጤም ዜጎች ህይወት ማለፉ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp dhimmota niwukilaraa fi baninsa daandii galaana Hormuz irratti marii gaggeessuuf yeroo waan gaafatameef, tarkaanfii waraanaa Iran irratti fudhachuuf qophaa'an kana gadi dhiisanii jiru. Murtoon kun kan dhufe erga Iran buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Yordaanos keessa jiru irratti xiyyaaraa kanaan miidhaa geessistee fi hogganoonni naannichaa, keessattuu ilmi mootii Sa'udii, mariin akka furmaataatti akka fayyadamu dhiibbaa erga godhanii booda dha. Gama biraan, waraanni Israa'eel fi Gaazaa gidduu jiru itti fufee kan jiru yoo ta'u, haleellaa qilleensaatiin lubbuun lammiilee Falasxiin darbuun gabaafameera.

title: MBS and Trump talk over the phone
english: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and US President Donald Trump held a phone call to discuss regional stability. The Prince emphasized the need for dialogue and a truce to prevent an escalating conflict in the area. This conversation followed Saudi concerns regarding potential US military strikes against Iran, which have since been called off.
amharic: የሳውዲ አልጋ ወራሽ መሀመድ ቢን ሳልማን እና የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በክልሉ ወቅታዊ ሁኔታዎች ላይ በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። አልጋ ወራሹ ግጭትን ለመከላከል እና መረጋጋትን ለማምጣት በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ መፍትሄ መፈለግ አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። ውይይቱ የተካሄደው ሳውዲ አረቢያ በአሜሪካ ሊወሰዱ በታቀዱ እና በኋላም በተሰረዙ የኢራን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ላይ ስጋቷን ከገለጸች በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Saudii fi Ameerikaa Mohammed bin Salman fi Donald Trump haala naannichaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun bilbilan mari'ataniiru. Igumaan Saudii waldhabdee jiru tasgabbeessuufi nagaa buusuuf mariin iddoo guddaa akka qabu ibsan. Mariin kunis kan taasifame erga Saudii tarkaanfii waraanaa Ameerikaan Iran irratti fudhachuuf karoorfattanii fi booda haqame san irratti yaaddoo ishee ibsitee booda.

title: How Davutoglu helped shape Erdogan’s Turkiye but failed to challenge it
english: Ahmet Davutoglu, a former Turkish prime minister and key architect of the nation's foreign policy, has announced his retirement from active politics and the dissolution of his Future Party. Once a close ally of President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, Davutoglu gained prominence for his 'strategic depth' doctrine which expanded Turkey's regional influence. Despite his intellectual contributions to the ruling AK Party, he ultimately struggled to build a successful independent opposition movement, citing a desire to distance himself from the current political climate.
amharic: የቀድሞው የቱርክ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር እና የሀገሪቱ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ዋና አቀንቃኝ የነበሩት አህመት ዳውቶግሉ፣ ከፖለቲካ ህይወታቸው ጡረታ መውጣታቸውን እና የራሳቸውን ፓርቲ መበተናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ዳውቶግሉ በአንድ ወቅት የፕሬዚዳንት ረሲፕ ታይፕ ኤርዶغان የቅርብ አጋር የነበሩ ሲሆን፣ የቱርክን የዲፕሎማሲ ተጽዕኖ ያስፋፋውን 'ስትራቴጂክ ጥልቀት' የተሰኘ ዶክትሪን በመቅረጽ ይታወቃሉ። ምንም እንኳን ለገዢው ፓርቲ ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ ያደረጉ ምሁር ቢሆኑም፣ በኋላ ላይ የራሳቸውን ተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ ለማጠናከር ተቸግረው የቱርክን የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ በመሸሽ ከፖለቲካው አለም ሙሉ ለሙሉ ለመገለል ወስነዋል።
oromo: Muummee ministiraa duraanii kan Turkiyaa fi hayyuu siyaasa alaa kan turan Ahmet Davutoglu, siyaasa irraa akka fagaatan fi paartii isaanii kan 'Future Party' akka diigan beeksisaniiru. Davutoglu yeroo dheeraaf pirezidaantii Recep Tayyip Erdogan waliin hojjechaa kan turan yoo ta'u, yaada 'strategic depth' jedhamuun dhiibbaa dippiloomaasii Turkiyaa naannichatti babal'isuun beekamu. Haa ta'u malee, erga paartii bulchaa keessaa bahanii booda paartii mormituu ofii isaanii ijaaruu dadhabuun, haala siyaasaa biyyattii amma jiru irraa fagaachuuf jecha siyaasaa gadi dhiisuu murteessaniiru.

title: Trump ‘cancels attack on Iran’ saying deal is near
english: Former US President Donald Trump stated he called off a military strike against Iran, claiming that the two nations were close to reaching an agreement. Despite this move, his inconsistent statements have created significant confusion and irritation within Iran. The situation remains tense as the shift in diplomatic tone leaves the actual path forward between the two countries uncertain.
amharic: የአሜሪካው የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ ሊፈጽሙት የነበረውን ጥቃት በስምምነት አቅራቢያ በመሆናቸው ምክንያት መሰረዛቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የፕሬዝዳንቱ ተለዋዋጭ ንግግሮች በኢራን በኩል ከፍተኛ ግራ መጋባትን እና ቅሬታን ፈጥረዋል። በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ሁኔታ አሁንም እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ እና ውጥረት በተሞላበት ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pirezidaantichi duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp, Itoophiyaan waliigaltee irra gahuu danda'u waan jiruuf, Itoophiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfatanii turan haquu isaanii ibsaniiru. Ta'us, dubbiin isaanii kan wal-hin fakkaanne kun Itoophiyaa keessatti gaaffii fi aarii guddaa uumeera. Hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii amma iyyuu kan hin mirkanaa’in fi rakkoo keessa kan jiruudha.

title: Petro urges global support to stop possible US invasion of Cuba
english: Outgoing Colombian President Gustavo Petro is calling for international support to prevent a potential US military intervention in Cuba. Petro issued this warning during his final official international visit before ending his term. He urged global leaders to take a stand to avoid such an escalation.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው ወጪ ፕሬዝዳንት ጉስታቮ ፔትሮ፣ አሜሪካ በኩባ ላይ ልትፈጽም ትችላለች ብለው የሰጉትን ወረራ ለመከላከል ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። ፔትሮ ይህንን ጥሪ ያቀረቡት ከስልጣን መልቀቂያቸው በፊት ባደረጉት የመጨረሻው የውጭ አገር ጉብኝት ወቅት ነው። ማንኛውንም አይነት ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነት ለማስቀረት የዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ በጋራ እንዲቆም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kolombiyaa aangoo gadi lakkisaa jiran Gustaavo Peetroon, Ameerikaan Kuubaa irratti waraana banuu dandeessi jedhanii waan sodaataniif, kana ittisuuf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa gaafataniiru. Peetroon yaada kana kan ibsan gara aangootti dhufuun isaanii dura imala isaanii isa dhumaa biyyoota alaa irratti dha. Guddina waraana kanaa dhaabsisuuf biyyoonni addunyaa waliin ta'anii tarkaanfii fudhachuu akka qaban dhaamaniiru.

title: Lionel Messi returns for Inter Miami after extended post-World Cup break
english: Lionel Messi has officially returned to play for Inter Miami following a break after the World Cup final. He appeared as a substitute in a 2-2 draw against the Columbus Crew, a match that featured goals from Luis Suarez and Noah Allen. Although Messi had several opportunities to score late in the game, the match concluded in a tie, ending his team's six-game winning streak.
amharic: ሊዮኔል ሜሲ ከዓለም ዋንጫ ፍጻሜ በኋላ ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ከሜዳ ከራቀ በኋላ በይፋ ወደ ኢንተር ማያሚ ተመልሷል። ሜሲ በኮሎምበስ ክሩ ላይ በተደረገው እና 2 ለ 2 በተጠናቀቀው ጨዋታ ላይ እንደ ተቀያሪ ተጫዋች ተሳትፏል። በጨዋታው ሉዊስ ሱዋሬዝ እና ኖህ አለን ግቦችን ያስቆጠሩ ሲሆን፣ ሜሲ የድል ግብ ለማስቆጠር ጥረት ቢያደርግም አልተሳካለትም። ይህ አቻ ውጤት የኢንተር ማያሚን የስድስት ጨዋታዎች ተከታታይ የድል ጉዞ አስቁሟል።
oromo: Lionel Messi taphichi xumura waancaa addunyaa booda boqonnaa fudhateen booda gara garee Inter Miami deebi'ee jira. Messi tapha Columbus Crew waliin 2-2 xumurame irratti bakka bu'ee kan galte yoo ta'u, taphichis gola Luis Suarez fi Noah Allenin galchame qaba. Messi xumura taphichaa irratti carraa gola galchuuf argate haa qabaatu malee, taphichi qixxee xumuramuu isaatiin rikkardii injifannoo walitti aansuun taphatamaa ture sun dhaabateera.

title: Tarik Skubal acquired by LA Dodgers at the MLB trade deadline
english: The Los Angeles Dodgers have strengthened their pitching rotation by acquiring star pitcher Tarik Skubal from the Detroit Tigers in a significant trade. Skubal, a two-time Cy Young Award winner, joins a powerhouse team already featuring Shohei Ohtani as they aim to win a third consecutive World Series title. In exchange for the elite pitcher, the Tigers received three minor league prospects to help rebuild their team.
amharic: የሎስ አንጀለስ ዶጀርስ የቤዝቦል ቡድን ኮከብ ተጫዋች የሆነውን ታሪክ ስኩባልን ከዲትሮይት ታይገርስ በከፍተኛ ዝውውር አስፈርሟል። ሁለት ጊዜ የሳይ ያንግ ሽልማት አሸናፊ የሆነው ስኩባል፣ ሾሄይ ኦታኒ ከሚገኝበት እና ለሶስተኛ ተከታታይ የዓለም ተከታታይ ዋንጫ ከሚፋለመው የዶጀርስ ቡድን ጋር ተቀላቅሏል። ለዚህ ልውውጥ ሲባል የዲትሮይት ታይገርስ በምላሹ ሶስት ወጣት ተጫዋቾችን ተቀብለዋል።
oromo: Garee beisbolii Los Angeles Dodgers gaggeessaa kubbaa (pitcher) beekamaa Tarik Skubal garee Detroit Tigers irraa jijjiirraa guddaadhaan bitateera. Injifataa badhaasa Cy Young si’a lamaa kan ta’e Skubal, garee Shohei Ohtani of keessaa qabuufi mata duree World Series si’a sadii walitti aansee injifachuuf karoorfatu kanaitti makameera. Jijjiirraa kanaaf jecha, gareen Detroit Tigers ammoo bakka isaatti taphattoota dargaggoota sadii argataniiru.

title: Three children among nine killed since dawn in Gaza
english: At least nine Palestinians have died following Israeli military strikes across Gaza since early morning. The casualties included three children, with attacks reported in Gaza City, Deir el-Balah, and Khan Younis. These incidents highlight the ongoing loss of civilian life in the region.
amharic: ከዛሬ ማለዳ ጀምሮ በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት በጋዛ ዘጠኝ ፍልስጤማውያን መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ከተገደሉት መካከል ሦስት ህጻናት የሚገኙበት ሲሆን ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በጋዛ ከተማ፣ በዴር አል-ባላህ እና በካን ዩኒስ ነው። ይህ የጥቃት ክስተት በክልሉ የሚገኙ ሲቪሎች እየደረሰባቸው ያለውን አሳዛኝ የሞት አደጋ ያሳያል።
oromo: Ganama har'aa irraa eegalee haleellaa waraana Israa'eel gara garaa Gaazaatti geggeeffameen namoonni sagal lubbuun darbaniiru. Namoota du'an keessaa ijoolleen sadii kan argaman yoo ta'u, haleellaan kunis magaalota Gaazaa, Deyr al-Balaah fi Khaan Yuunis keessatti raawwatameera. Haleellaan kun namoota nagaa irratti miidhaa cimaa geessisaa jira.

title: At least three dead in Idaho shopping mall mass shooting
english: A tragic shooting occurred at an In-N-Out Burger in Twin Falls, Idaho, on Saturday, resulting in the deaths of at least three people. Several other individuals sustained injuries during the violent attack. Authorities confirmed that the suspect was also killed after firing shots at a vehicle.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በአሜሪካ አይዳሆ ግዛት ትዊን ፎልስ በሚገኝ ኢን-ኤን-አውት በርገር ምግብ ቤት በተፈጸመ ተኩስ ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በተጨማሪም በርካታ ሰዎች በአደጋው መቁሰላቸው ተገልጿል። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ግለሰብ ተሽከርካሪ ላይ ተኩስ ከከፈተ በኋላ በፖሊስ እርምጃ ተገድሏል።
oromo: Guyyaa Sanbata darbe magaalaa Twin Falls, Idaho kan argamu mana nyaataa In-N-Out Burger keessatti dhukaasa cimaa uumameen namoonni yoo xiqqaate sadii du'aniiru. Namoonni biroos hedduun miidhaan irra ga'eera. Akkuma dubbichi raawwatameen, shakkamaan dhukaasa kana bane kunis konkolaataa tokko irratti erga dhukaasee booda humnoota nageenyaan ajjeefameera.

title: Gaza students overcome Israel’s genocide to mark Tawjihi results
english: Despite the ongoing war and extreme hardships in Gaza, students have successfully completed their Tawjihi high school exams. Siblings Sama, Abdullah, and Nada Musa achieved high marks through significant personal effort and family support. Their success highlights the resilience of Palestinian youth who continue to prioritize their education even in the face of conflict and displacement.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነትና አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥም ተማሪዎች የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርታቸውን አጠናቀው ፈተናቸውን በስኬት አልፈዋል። ሳማ፣ አብዱላህ እና ናዳ ሙሳ የተባሉ እህትማማቾች በቤተሰቦቻቸው ድጋፍና በጽናት ከፍተኛ ውጤት በማምጣት ትምህርታቸው ላይ ትኩረት አድርገዋል። ይህ ስኬት ተማሪዎቹ በግጭትና በችግር መካከልም ቢሆን ለትምህርት ያላቸውን ከፍተኛ ተነሳሽነት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Gaza keessatti waraanaafi haala ulfaataa jiru keessatti illee, barattoonni qormaata barnoota sadarkaa lammaffaa Tawjihi jedhamu milkaa'inaan xumiraniiru. Obboloonni Samaa, Abdullaahiifi Naadaan maatii isaanii irraa deggarsa argataniifi jabaatanii hojjechuun isaaniitiin qabxii olaanaa galmeessisaniiru. Milkaa'inni kun, barattoonni Falastiin haala waraanaafi buqqaatii keessatti illee barnoota isaaniif dursaa kennuudhaan jabina akka qaban argisiisa.

title: Three dead including female bomber in Moscow restaurant attack
english: A bomb explosion outside a restaurant in downtown Moscow has resulted in at least three fatalities and over twenty injuries. Russian officials reported that a security guard intercepted a woman carrying the explosive device shortly before the blast occurred. The specific motivation behind the attack and the intended target remain under investigation.
amharic: በሞስኮ መሀል ከተማ በሚገኝ ምግብ ቤት ውጭ በደረሰ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከሃያ በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። የሩሲያ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለፁት ፍንዳታው የደረሰው ፍንዳታ የያዘች ሴት በፀጥታ ጠባቂ ከታገደች በኋላ ነው። ለጥቃቱ የተነሳሱበት ምክንያት ወይም ኢላማቸው ማን እንደሆነ እስካሁን አልታወቀም።
oromo: Magaalaa Moskoo giddu galeessaatti mana nyaata tokko dura mi'a dhootuun erga dhootee booda, namoonni yoo xiqqaate sadan lubbuun darbanii fi namoonni 20 ol ta'an miidhamaniiru. Aangeyyoonni Raashiyaa akka ibsanitti, dhugaatiin kun kan mudate erga waardiyyaan nageenyaa tokko dubartii mi'a dhootu baattee turte to'annoo jala oolchuu yaaltee boodadha. Kaayyoon fi namni gareen kun xiyyeeffannoo irra ture hanga ammaatti ifa miti.

title: Why isn’t anyone challenging Infantino for FIFA’s top job?
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino is facing no challengers for his upcoming re-election, despite recent backlash over his proposal to sell World Cup stakes to private investors. Although he withdrew the controversial plan following global criticism, his position remains unchallenged. This lack of opposition raises questions about the current political climate within the organization as he prepares for another term.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ለቀጣዩ ምርጫ ምንም አይነት ተቀናቃኝ ሳይገጥማቸው በስልጣን ለመቆየት ተዘጋጅተዋል። የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ አቅደው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በደረሰባቸው ዓለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞ ምክንያት እቅዱን ሰርዘውታል። ሆኖም በተቋሙ ውስጥ ተፎካካሪ አለመኖሩ በፊፋ የውስጥ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ ጥያቄዎችን እያስነሳ ይገኛል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo filannoo dhufuuf qophaa'aa jiran keessatti morkataan tokkollee isa mudatee hin jiru. Yeroo dhihoo asitti gabaa fiilmii tapha kubbaa miillaa adunyaa investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfatanii turan garuu, mormii guddaa hordofee karooricha haqaniiru. Haata'u malee, dhaabbatichatti morkataan dhabamuun isaanii haala siyaasii FIFA irratti gaaffilee garaa garaa kaasuun isaa ibsameera.

title: Israeli forces claim Hamas commanders killed in Gaza
english: The Israeli military reported the deaths of two Hamas commanders following separate airstrikes in Gaza over the weekend. One official, identified as a special forces leader, was accused of participating in the October 2023 attacks, while the other was a battalion commander. These operations were carried out by Israeli forces in both southern and central parts of the Gaza Strip.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ባለፈው ሳምንት መጨረሻ በጋዛ ባደረገው የአየር ጥቃት ሁለት የሃማስ አዛዦችን መግደሉን አስታውቋል። ከተገደሉት መካከል አንደኛው የጥቅምት 2023 ጥቃት ተሳታፊ እንደነበረ የተገለጸ ሲሆን ሁለተኛው ደግሞ የባታሊዮን አዛዥ እንደነበር ተገልጿል። ጥቃቶቹ የተፈጸሙት በጋዛ ደቡባዊ እና መካከለኛ ክፍሎች ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el dhuma torban darbe qilleensa irraan haleellaa Gazaatti geggeesseen ajajoota Hamas lama ajjeesuu isaa beeksise. Isaan keessaa tokko weerara Onkoloolessa 2023 keessatti hirmaachuu isaa kan ibsame yoo ta'u, inni biraan ammoo ajajaa battaliyoonaa akka ture ibsameera. Haleellaan kunis kutaa kibbaa fi giddu galeessa Gazaatti raawwatameera.

title: Hamas, PIJ stress full Israeli withdrawal from Gaza
english: Leaders from Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad met in Cairo to coordinate their strategy regarding the ongoing conflict. The groups collectively demanded a total Israeli military withdrawal from Gaza and an end to current hostilities. Furthermore, they discussed ways to unify their efforts in response to rising tensions in the West Bank and the treatment of Palestinian prisoners.
amharic: የሃማስ እና የፍልስጤም እስላማዊ ጂሃድ መሪዎች በካይሮ ተገናኝተው አሁን ስላለው ግጭት መክረዋል። ሁለቱ ቡድኖች እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንድታስወጣ እና ጥቃቷን እንድታቆም በጋራ ጠይቀዋል። በተጨማሪም በምዕራብ ባንክ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ውጥረት እና በፍልስጤማውያን እስረኞች ላይ የሚደርሰውን በደል ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል የጋራ አቋም ለመያዝ ተወያይተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Hamas fi Islamic Jihad kan Falastin Kaayirootti wal arguun tarsiimoo isaanii irratti mari'ataniiru. Gareewwan kunneen Israa'el loltoota ishee Gaza keessaa guutummaatti akka baastuufi lola ishee akka dhaabdu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, naannoo West Bank keessatti rakkoolee dabalaa jiraniifi haala hidhamtoota Falastin irratti xiyyeeffachuun, akkaataa tokkummaan itti socho'an irratti mari'ataniiru.

title: Morning recap
english: President Trump has paused potential military strikes against Iran, seeking a swift diplomatic agreement regarding their nuclear program and maritime security. Meanwhile, Iran has threatened a firm response to any American hostility, citing recent missile strikes on a base in Jordan as a demonstration of their capabilities. Despite the talk of de-escalation, conflict persists in the region, with Israeli airstrikes in Gaza and ongoing instability causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የኢራንን የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም እና የባህር ላይ ደህንነትን ለመቆጣጠር ፈጣን ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ በማለም በኢራን ላይ ሊፈጽሙት የነበረውን ጥቃት ለጊዜው አግደዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን በማንኛውም የአሜሪካ ጥቃት ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች፤ በጆርዳን የሚገኝ የአሜሪካ የጦር ሰፈር ላይ ባደረሰችው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃትም ይህንኑ አሳይታለች። ምንም እንኳን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ንግግሮች ቢኖሩም በጋዛ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት መቀጠሉን እና የሲቪል ህዝቡ ላይ ጉዳት መድረሱን እንዲሁም በክልሉ ያለው አለመረጋጋት መቀጠሉን ዘገባዎች ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Pirezidanti Traamp sagantaa niwukilaraa Iiraan fi nageenya galaanaarratti waliigaltee saffisaa irra ga’uuf jechuudhaan, haleellaa waraanaa Iiraaniirratti raawwachuuf karoorfate ture yeroof dhaabeera. Gama biraatiin, Iiraan haleellaa Ameerikaa kamiyyuuf tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf qophii ta’uu ishee ibsitee, buufata waraana Ameerikaa Yordaanos keessa jiru irratti haleellaa misaayilii raawwachuun ishee kana mirkaneesseera. Ta’us, karaa dipiloomaasii irratti mariin yoo jiraates, Gaza keessatti haleellaan Israa’el kan itti fufe yoo ta’u, kunis lubbuu namoota nagaa fi miidhaa qaamaa biroo akka geessise gabaafameera.

title: Israeli settlers cut electricity poles in Nablus, report says
english: Israeli settlers damaged electrical infrastructure in the Palestinian village of Madama near Nablus, leading to a localized power outage. This incident is part of a growing trend of violent acts by settlers across the West Bank, which have recently included targeting homes, farmland, and religious sites. These actions reflect an ongoing surge in regional tensions affecting Palestinian communities.
amharic: የእስራኤል ሰፈራ ነዋሪዎች በናብሉስ አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው ማዳማ መንደር የኤሌክትሪክ ምሰሶዎችን በማውደማቸው የተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች ለኃይል መቆራረጥ ተዳርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በቅርብ ጊዜ በዌስት ባንክ በፓሌስቲናውያን ቤቶች፣ በግብርና መሬቶች እና በሃይማኖታዊ ስፍራዎች ላይ እየተካሄደ ካለው የጥቃት ማዕበል አንዱ አካል ነው። እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች በአካባቢው ያለውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ አባብሰዋል።
oromo: Buqqaatoonni Israa'el ganda Maadaamaa kan Naablusitti argamutti utubaa elektirikii mancaasuun naannicha keessatti humna ibsaa akka addaan citu taasisaniiru. Gochi kun, dhiheenya kana naannoo West Baankitti manneen, lafa qonnaa fi bakkeewwan amantii irratti miidhaa qaqqabaa jiru keessaa isa tokko. Tarkaanfiin kunis walitti bu'iinsa fi sodaa naannichatti babal'achaa jiru mul'isa.

title: Israeli forces detain three Palestinians during raid in Bethlehem
english: Israeli military forces conducted an operation in the Dheisheh refugee camp near Bethlehem, resulting in the arrest of three Palestinian men. During the raid, troops inspected multiple homes and placed intimidating messages on a local mosque. The forces also searched a private residence in the center of Bethlehem during the same security sweep.

title: Trump says he is cancelling strikes on Iran subject to 'rapidly' making deal
english: President Trump has called off planned military strikes against Iran, opting instead to pursue a rapid diplomatic agreement. The proposed deal requires Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz and completely dismantle its nuclear program. This decision follows pressure from regional nations to avoid conflict, although the US remains prepared to act if these terms are not met.

title: How Virunga Park protects people and gorillas from Ebola in eastern DRC
english: Virunga National Park in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is implementing strict health measures to prevent the spread of Ebola among local communities and endangered mountain gorillas. The park has established six monitoring checkpoints equipped with temperature screening and isolation units to track movement and contain the virus. By deploying paramedics and providing essential medical supplies, park authorities are acting as a critical buffer to control the current outbreak.

oromo: Paarkii Biyyooleessa Virungaa kan Rippabiliika Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti argamu, vaayirasii Ibolaa namootaafi gorilaa bosonaa miidhamuu malan irraa ittisuuf tarkaanfii fayyaa cimaa fudhachaa jira. title: Trump cancels Iran strike, says ‘deal perimeters’ reached
english: President Donald Trump has called off a planned military strike against Iran, stating that both nations have established the basic framework for a new agreement. This decision follows diplomatic appeals from Middle Eastern leaders and is intended to resolve issues regarding Iran's nuclear program and access to the Strait of Hormuz. While the US government has issued travel warnings for the region due to high tensions, no official confirmation of this deal has been provided by Tehran.

title: Israel kills eight in Gaza despite Trump’s Hamas disarmament plan
english: Israeli military strikes across Gaza have resulted in at least eight Palestinian deaths, despite a new U.S.-backed proposal aimed at disarmament and a ceasefire. While President Trump's recent roadmap attempts to end the conflict, intense fighting continues as both Israel and Hamas remain deadlocked over the conditions for withdrawal and weapon surrender. The situation remains unstable, with recent attacks also causing significant damage to essential civilian infrastructure like medical supply warehouses.

title: Is criticism of Spain on border management legitimate or politics?
english: A significant influx of migrants entering the Spanish territory of Ceuta from Morocco has triggered a heated debate regarding border management and immigration policies. Some European nations have responded by imposing stricter border controls, challenging Spain's generally open approach to migration. This situation has drawn international attention, including commentary from US officials, as experts analyze whether these criticisms are based on genuine policy concerns or political maneuvering.

title: US embassies issue alerts after Trump vows to hit Iran ‘hard’
english: United States embassies across the Middle East have issued security alerts following President Trump's public warning that the U.S. would take strong action against Iran. While these warnings suggest a potential increase in regional tensions, officials note that there is currently no evidence indicating an immediate military strike. The situation remains under close observation as authorities prepare for possible repercussions.

title: Former Israeli prime minister vows to declare Qatar ‘enemy’ if elected
english: Former Israeli Prime Minister Naftali Bennett has stated that he would label Qatar an enemy state if he returns to office. He claims that Qatar poses a significant threat by funding militant groups, influencing American institutions, and operating media channels that damage Israel’s interests. Bennett expressed deep frustration that Israel has not already officially designated Qatar as a hostile nation.

oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii Israa'el Naftaali Beneet yoo gara aangootti deebi'an qatarin akka biyya diinaatti kan labsan ta'uu ibsan. Qatar garee hidhattootaaf deeggarsa maallaqaa gochuun, dhaabbilee Ameerikaa keessatti dhiibbaa uumuun, akkasumas Israa'eliin kan miidhu oduu labsuun balaa guddaa akka geessisaa jirtu dubbataniiru. Israa'el hamma ammaatti qatarin sirriitti biyya diinaa jechuu dhabuu isheetti gadda guddaa qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Two children among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
english: Israeli military airstrikes in Gaza killed at least eight people, including two children, during the night. These attacks occurred across multiple locations, including central Gaza, Gaza City, and Khan Younis, despite ongoing discussions regarding a potential ceasefire agreement. The strikes targeted various residential buildings, resulting in multiple casualties and damage to essential infrastructure.
amharic: በጋዛ በተፈጸሙ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ስምንት ሰዎች የተገደሉ ሲሆን ከሟቾቹ መካከል ሁለት ህጻናት ይገኙበታል። ጥቃቶቹ የተፈጸሙት የጦርነት ማቆም ስምምነት ውይይቶች እየተካሄዱ ባሉበት ወቅት ነው። ጥቃቶቹ በመካከለኛው ጋዛ፣ በጋዛ ከተማ እና በካን ዩኒስ በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ሲሆን በርካታ ጉዳቶችን አስከትለዋል።
oromo: Halkan darbetti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el gaazaatti raawwattee kanaan ijoollee lama dabalatee namoonni saddeet ol du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun mariin nagaa fi waraana dhaabuu ilaalchisee adeemsifamaa jiru utuu jiruu bakkeewwan garagaraatti kan raawwatame dha. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa kanneen akka Giddugaleessa Gaazaa, Magaalaa Gaazaa fi Kaani Yuuniis keessatti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, lubbuu galaftachuu malees miidhaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: 10 more US refuelling planes to join 30 already stationed in Israel
english: The United States military plans to send ten more aerial refueling aircraft to Israel soon. These planes will be added to the thirty that are already currently based at Ben Gurion Airport. This move increases the total number of American refueling support planes operating within the country.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ አስር ተጨማሪ የነዳጅ ማደያ አውሮፕላኖችን ወደ እስራኤል ለመላክ አቅዷል። እነዚህ አውሮፕላኖች በቤን ጉሪዮን አየር ማረፊያ አስቀድመው ከነበሩት ሰላሳ አውሮፕላኖች ጋር የሚቀላቀሉ ይሆናል። ይህ እርምጃ በእስራኤል ውስጥ የሚገኙ የአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ድጋፍ ሰጪ አውሮፕላኖች ቁጥር እንዲጨምር ያደርጋል።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa xiyyaarota boba'aa dhiyeessan dabalataa kudhan gara Israa'elitti ergachuuf qophaa'aa jira. Xiyyaarotni kunneen buufata xiyyaaraa Ben Gurion keessatti xiyyaarota ammaa achi jiran soddoma irratti kan dabalaman ta'a. Tarkaanfiin kun waliigala xiyyaarota deeggarsa boba'aa Ameerikaa biyyattii keessatti argamanii ni dabala.

title: Fire breaks out in Iraq’s Kurdish region after drone attack
english: A drone strike targeted the 70th Brigade headquarters of the Peshmerga forces in Sulaimaniyah, Iraq. Security forces successfully intercepted the drone, but debris from the incident landed nearby and sparked a fire. No injuries were reported, and officials confirmed the blaze was contained.
amharic: በኢራቅ ሱለይማኒያ ከተማ በሚገኘው የፔሽመርጋ ኃይሎች ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት ተፈጽሟል። የፀጥታ ኃይሎች ድሮኑን መትተው መጣል ቢችሉም፣ የወደቀው ፍርስራሽ በአቅራቢያው እሳት እንዲነሳ አድርጓል። በጥቃቱ የደረሰ ጉዳት የለም።
oromo: Magala Sulaymaniyaa kan Iraq keessatti bakka buufata waraana Peshmerga irratti haleellaan xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) raawwatamee jira. Humnoonni nageenyaa xiyyaricha rukutanii kuffisuu danda'aniiru, garuu caccabaan isaa bakka sunitti gadi bu'uun ibidda kaaseera. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuu hin geenye.

title: Trump says cancelled attack on Iran subject to Hormuz opening, end to 'nuclear threat'
english: Donald Trump has decided to call off a planned military strike against Iran following requests from regional partners to negotiate. He stated that the attack was paused to allow time for a new agreement that would secure the Strait of Hormuz and eliminate Iran's nuclear program. The former president emphasized that this decision was made in hopes of achieving global stability and long-term prosperity for Iran.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከክልሉ አጋሮች በደረሳቸው ጥያቄ መሠረት በኢራን ላይ ለመፈጸም አቅደውት የነበረውን ጥቃት ሰርዘዋል። ጥቃቱ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን ለመክፈትና የኢራንን የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም ለማስቆም የሚደረገውን ድርድር ለመቀጠል ሲባል መታገዱን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ለዓለም ሰላምና ለኢራን ዘላቂ ጥቅም ሲባል እንደሆነም ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Doonald Traamp gamtoota naannichaa irraa gaaffii dhiyaateef deebii kennuun, weerara Iraan irratti raawwachuuf karoorfate ture dhaabuu isaa beeksisaniiru. Weerarichi kan dhaabate, daandii galaana Hormuz banuufi sagantaa nukileraa Iraan dhaabsisuuf mariin akka adeemsifamuufi. Tarkaanfiin kunis nageenya addunyaafi fayidaa Iraan gara fuulduraatiif yaadamee kan fudhatame ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Right-sizing Tests Addis Abeba University’s Promise for Autonomy
english: Addis Ababa University's transition to autonomy has resulted in a significant organizational restructuring that has left hundreds of staff members without current placements. While management claims that no one has been officially fired, many experienced academics and administrative employees face uncertainty regarding retirement, compensation, or potential reassignment. These workers are now waiting to see if the university will provide them with new roles before their existing contracts expire.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ወደ ራሱ በራስ የመተዳደር መብት መሸጋገሩን ተከትሎ በተደረገው አጠቃላይ የመዋቅር ለውጥ የተነሳ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰራተኞች ያለ ስራ ቆይተዋል። የዩኒቨርሲቲው አስተዳደር ማንም ሰው በይፋ እንዳልተባረረ ቢገልጽም፣ በርካታ ልምድ ያላቸው መምህራን እና የአስተዳደር ሰራተኞች የጡረታ፣ የካሳ ወይም ወደ ሌላ ስራ የመዛወር እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ሰራተኞች ኮንትራታቸው ከማለቁ በፊት አዲስ የስራ እድል ይፈጠርላቸው እንደሆነ በመጠባበቅ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Yunivarsitiin Finfinnee gara ofiin bulmaataatti ce'uun isaa fi jijjiirramni caasaa taasifame hojjettoota dhibbaan lakkaawwaman hojii irraa akka adda ba'an taasiseera. Bulchiinsi yunivarsitiichaa namni tokkollee hojii irraa akka hin ari'amne ibsuus, barsiisonni fi hojjettoonni bulchiinsa hedduun mirga sooramaa, kafaltii kafaltii ykn gara hojii biraatti jijjiirramuu irratti amansiisaa hin taane keessatti argamu. Hojjettoonni kunneen kontiraanni isaanii osoo hin dhumatin hojiin haaraan akka kennamuuf eegaa jiru.

title: Tax Bills Outrun the Metre, Stalling Ride-hailing Drivers
english: Ride-hailing drivers in Addis Ababa are struggling with unexpectedly high tax assessments amidst soaring fuel prices and operational challenges. Because they lack a formal association to advocate for them or a clear process to challenge these bills, many are abandoning digital platforms. Consequently, these drivers are returning to traditional street-side pickups to avoid taxes and survive financially.
amharic: በአዲስ አበባ የሚሰሩ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎት ሰጪዎች ያልጠበቁት ከፍተኛ የግብር ክፍያ በመጣለበት እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረትን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ተግዳሮቶች ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ችግሮቻቸውን የሚወክሉላቸው ማህበራት ባለመኖራቸው እና አቤቱታ የሚያቀርቡበት ግልጽ መንገድ ስላልተመቻቸላቸው፣ ብዙዎቹ ከዲጂታል መተግበሪያዎች እየወጡ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት ሹፌሮቹ ከግብር መረብ ውጪ ለመሆን በማሰብ ተመልሰው በጎዳና ላይ ተሳፋሪዎችን መጫን ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni tajaajila geejjibaa (ride-hailing) Finfinnee keessatti hojjetan, gibira guddaa isaan hin eegne fi gatii boba’aa dabalaa dhufuun kanneen isaan dhibe ta’eera. Dhimma isaaniif falmuuf gamtaan waan hin jirreef akkasumas karaa ifa ta’e kan komii itti dhiyeeffatan waan hin jirreef, ogeeyyonni hedduun appilikeshiinota dijitaala irraa gadi ba’aa jiru. Kana irraa kan ka’es, gibira irraa bilisa ta’uuf jechuudha, ganda keessatti harka qulleessa imaltoota fe’uu eegalaniiru.

title: Shipping Lines Charts Biggest-Ever Fleet Plan After Buying None Planned for the Year
english: The Ethiopian Shipping and Logistics enterprise has announced a major expansion strategy to acquire 16 new vessels by 2031, aiming to increase its cargo capacity by 161 percent. Although the company failed to purchase any of the six ships it initially planned to acquire this year due to procurement delays, officials maintain that the ambitious expansion plan remains on track. This initiative represents the largest fleet growth in the company's history despite ongoing concerns regarding its execution capacity.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የባህር ትራንስፖርትና ሎጂስቲክስ አገልግሎት እስከ 2031 ዓ.ም ድረስ 16 አዳዲስ መርከቦችን በመግዛት የካርጎ አቅሙን በ161 በመቶ ለማሳደግ የሚያስችል ትልቅ እቅድ ይፋ አድርጓል። ድርጅቱ በያዝነው አመት ሊገዛቸው ያቀዳቸውን ስድስት መርከቦች በግዥ መዘግየት ምክንያት ባይገዛም፣ የሥራ ኃላፊዎች ግዙፉን የማስፋፊያ ፕሮግራም እንደሚቀጥሉ ገልጸዋል። ይህ እቅድ በድርጅቱ ታሪክ ትልቁ የመርከብ ማስፋፊያ ቢሆንም፣ የድርጅቱን የአፈጻጸም አቅም በተመለከተ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Hojiiwwan Teesdoo fi Logistikii Itoophiyaa hanga bara 2031-tti markaboota haarawa 16 bituun dandeettii fe'umsaa isaa dhibbeentaa 161-n guddisuuf karoora bal'aa baaseera. Dhaabbatichi bara kana markaboota ja'a bituuf karooratee ture gurgurtaa fi qophii keessatti rakkoo uumameen tokkollee bituu baatus, hooggantoonni garuu karoora guddinaa kana raawwachuuf murteessaniiru. Karoorri kun seenaa dhaabbatichaa keessatti kan guddicha ta'us, hojiirra oolmaa isaa ilaalchisee yaaddoon jira.

title: Ethiopian Eyes Bigger on Cargo as Costs Outrun Record Revenue
english: Ethiopian Airlines is expanding its cargo fleet by receiving eight new Boeing and Airbus freighters next week. This move aims to increase shipping capacity despite the airline facing challenges from rising operational costs that are outpacing its record-breaking revenue. The company is betting that this significant investment will help stabilize its financial growth in the long term.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ አየር መንገድ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት ስምንት አዳዲስ የጭነት አውሮፕላኖችን በመረከብ የካርጎ አገልግሎቱን ለማስፋፋት እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ምንም እንኳን አየር መንገዱ ከፍተኛ ገቢ እያገኘ ቢሆንም፣ እየጨመረ የመጣው የወጪ ጫና ፈተና ሆኖበታል። አየር መንገዱ ይህን የአውሮፕላን ጭማሪ የገቢ አቅሙን ለማሳደግ እና የገጠመውን የፋይናንስ ጫና ለመቋቋም ወሳኝ ስልት አድርጎ ይዞታል።
oromo: Intertii Itoophiyaa torban dhufu kanatti xiyyaarota fe'umsaa Boeing fi Airbus saddeet fudhachuun damee fe'umsaa isaa bal'isaa jira. Hojii kana kan geggeessaa jiru yeroo rakkoon baasii hojii guddachaa jiruutti yoo ta'u, kunis galii seena qabeessa argamee jiruuf dhiibbaa uumaa jira. Dhaabbatichi xiyyaarota haaraa kana dabalachuun dandeettii fe'umsaa guddisuufi galii isaa tasgabbeessuuf karoorfateera.

title: How Spain's migrant crisis created a political storm - whipped up by social media
english: A massive surge of migrants entering the Spanish territory of Ceuta has triggered a major political conflict across Europe. While most of the migrants were returned to Morocco, the incident led to dozens of deaths and sparked intense criticism from other EU nations, including Italy, regarding Spain's immigration policies. Critics argue that social media rumors and Spain's efforts to regularize undocumented workers are encouraging more people to attempt dangerous crossings.

oromo: Godaantonni hedduun gara daangaa Ispeen, Se’uutaa seenan kun, biyyoota Awurooppaa gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa siyaasaa guddaa uumeera. Godaantonni baay'een gara Morookootti deebifamanis, lammiileen hedduun galaana keessatti lubbuun darbuun isaa fi imaammata godaantotaa kan Ispeen irratti qeeqni cimaan biyyoota akka Xaaliyaanii fi gamtaa Awurooppaa biraa dhufeera. Qeeqtoonni akka jedhanitti, oduun sobaa miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti faca'uu fi carraaqqiin Ispeen godaantota heeyyama hin qabne karaa seera qabeessa gochuuf gootu, namoonni biroo daandii kana irratti lubbuu isaanii akka qabaniif sababa ta'aa jira jedhu.

title: Iran war live: Tehran warns of ‘decisive’ response to any US ‘aggression’
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has declared that Iran will launch a firm and calculated retaliation if the United States or Israel carries out any acts of aggression. This warning was communicated to regional leaders amid rising tensions following threats from President Donald Trump. Consequently, American embassies in the Middle East have advised their citizens to remain alert for potential instability.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ አሜሪካ ወይም እስራኤል ማንኛውንም አይነት ጥቃት ቢሰነዝሩ ኢራን ጠንካራ እና ተመጣጣኝ የሆነ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራንን እንደሚመቱ ካደረጉት ዛቻ በኋላ ውጥረቱ እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ ነው። በዚህም ምክንያት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ኤምባሲዎች ዜጎቻቸውን ሊከሰት ከሚችለው አለመረጋጋት እንዲጠነቀቁ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, yoo Ameerikaan ykn Israa'el tarkaanfii kamiyyuu fudhatan, Iraan deebii cimaa fi madaalawaa ta'e akka kennitu akeekkachiisaniiru. Akeekkachiisni kun kan kenname erga pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp Iraaniin haleeluuf sodaachisanii booda, yeroo walitti bu'iinsi naannichaa dabalaa jiruudha. Kana hordofuun, embasiin Ameerikaa naannawa Baha Giddu galeessatti argaman lammiilee isaanii gocha tasgabbii dhabsiisuu danda'uuf akka qophaa'an gorsaniiru.

title: Singapore bans UK band Massive Attack over Palestinian flag
english: Singaporean authorities have prohibited two members of the British musical group Massive Attack from returning to the country. This decision was made after the musicians displayed a Palestinian flag during a live performance. Officials stated that the act violated local regulations regarding unauthorized political demonstrations and the exhibition of foreign flags.
amharic: የሲንጋፖር ባለስልጣናት የብሪታንያው የሙዚቃ ቡድን ማሲቭ አታክ አባላት ወደ ሀገሪቱ እንዳይመለሱ ከልክለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው ሙዚቀኞቹ በመድረክ ላይ የፍልስጤም ባንዲራ በማውለብለባቸው ነው። ባለስልጣናቱ ድርጊቱ ያልተፈቀደ የፖለቲካ ተቃውሞ እና የውጭ ሀገር ባንዲራ ማሳየትን የሚከለክለውን የአካባቢውን ህግ የሚጥስ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Singaapoor miseensota garee muuziqaa Biritaaniyaa 'Massive Attack' ta'an lama gara biyyattii akka hin deebine dhorkeera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga muuziqeestonni kunneen yeroo sagantaa isaanii irratti alaabaa Filisxeem agarsiisanii booda dha. Abbootiin taayitaa akka ibsanitti, gochi kun seera biyyattii kan cabsuufi hayyama malee ibsa siyaasaa fi alaabaa biyya alaa agarsiisuu kan dhorgu dha.

title: New York Times reveals Trump administration subpoena over North Korea story
english: The New York Times recently disclosed that the Trump administration issued a subpoena to freelance journalist Matthew Cole regarding his reporting on a failed 2019 US Navy SEAL mission in North Korea. This legal move is part of a broader government effort to identify and prosecute the sources behind leaked classified information. The newspaper is providing legal support for Cole, who intends to protect his sources and defend press freedom against these government actions.
amharic: ኒው ዮርክ ታይምስ ጋዜጣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በሰሜን ኮሪያ ስለተካሄደ ያልተሳካ የባህር ኃይል ኦፕሬሽን ዘገባ ላቀረበው ጋዜጠኛ ማቲው ኮል የፍርድ ቤት ትእዛዝ መላኩን ይፋ አድርጓል። ይህ እርምጃ መንግስት በሚስጥር የተያዙ መረጃዎችን አሳልፈው የሚሰጡ ምንጮችን ለመለየት የሚያደርገው ጥረት አካል ነው። ጋዜጣው ለጋዜጠኛው የህግ ድጋፍ እያደረገ ሲሆን፣ ጋዜጠኛውም የዜና ምንጮቹን መረጃ ላለመስጠት እና የመገናኛ ብዙሃን ነጻነትን ለማስከበር እንደሚቆም አስታውቋል።
oromo: Gaazeexaan Niiw Yook Taayims akka gabaasetti, bulchiinsi Traamp gabaasa waa'ee duula waraana Naayibii Siiyilii (Navy SEALs) kan bara 2019 biyya Kooriyaa Kaabaatti fashale irratti odeeffannoo dhiyeesseef, gaazexessaa bilisaa Maatiw Kool irratti ajaja mana murtiitiin dirqisiisuu baasuu beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun mootummaan odeeffannoo icitii ta'e kan lakkisaniif (leaks) dhaqqabachuufi duubatti deebi'uuf yaalii godhu keessatti kan fudhatameedha. Gaazeexichi gaazexessichaaf gargaarsa seeraa kan kennaa jiru yoo ta'u, gaazexessichi maddawwan odeeffannoo isaa eeguufi bilisummaa miidiyaa kabachiisuuf cichuu isaa ibseera.

title: Growing like ‘gangbusters’: Can Taiwan maintain its economic momentum?
english: Taiwan's economy is experiencing rapid growth fueled by a massive surge in artificial intelligence chip exports to the United States. While this tech-driven boom has propelled the nation to become a leading global market player, experts caution that long-term sustainability remains uncertain. Potential geopolitical tensions involving China and Donald Trump, along with internal demographic shifts, pose significant risks to this current momentum.
amharic: የታይዋን ኢኮኖሚ ወደ አሜሪካ በሚላኩ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ቺፖች ከፍተኛ እድገት እያሳየ ይገኛል። ይህ በቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፍ የተመዘገበው ፈጣን እድገት አገሪቱን በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ተወዳዳሪ ቢፈጠርላትም፣ ባለሙያዎች ግን የረጅም ጊዜ ዘላቂነቱ አጠያያቂ መሆኑን ያስጠነቅቃሉ። በተለይም ከቻይና እና ከዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጋር የተያያዙ የጂኦፖለቲካዊ ውጥረቶች እንዲሁም የአገሪቱ የስነ-ህዝብ ለውጦች ለወደፊት ኢኮኖሚያዊ ስኬት ተግዳሮት ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
oromo: Diinagdeen Taayiwanii guddina ariifataa gara Ameerikaatti teknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' (AI) erguun galmeessaa jira. Guddinni teknoolojii irratti hundaa'e kun biyyattii gabaa addunyaa keessatti sadarkaa olaanaatti kan baase ta'us, ogeeyyiin garuu waggoota dhufan keessatti guddinni kun itti fufiinsa qabaachuu dhiisuu akka danda'u hubachiisu. Walitti bu'iinsi siyaasaa biyyoota alaa keessattuu kan Chaayinaa fi Doonaald Traamp, akkasumas jijjiiramni ummataa gara fuulduraatti guddina diinagdee kanaaf sodaa guddaa uumuu danda'u.

title: Child among four Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
english: Four Palestinians, including a child, lost their lives in two separate Israeli airstrikes on Sunday. These attacks occurred shortly after President Trump announced progress regarding a ceasefire deal that requires Hamas to disarm. Despite these diplomatic efforts, the recent violence underscores the ongoing instability in the Gaza Strip.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በተፈጸሙ ሁለት የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃቶች አንድ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ አራት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቶቹ የተፈጸሙት የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በጋዛ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ላይ መሻሻል መኖሩን ካስታወቁ በኋላ ነው። ይህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ግጭት በጋዛ ሰርጥ ያለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ አሁንም አለመረጋጋት ውስጥ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el lama geggeeffameen daa'ima tokko dabalatee Palestinootni afur lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame pirezidaant Traamp waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa irratti jijjiiramni jiraachuu erga beeksisanii booda. Gochi kun haala nageenyaa Gaaza keessatti mul'atu kan hin tasgabboofne ta'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Mexican activists call for end to water agreements with Israel
english: Activists in Mexico are urging their government to cancel water management partnerships with Israel. Protesters from various civil groups believe these agreements threaten local natural resources and are using the issue to express their opposition to Israel's military operations in Gaza. The demonstrations highlight a growing national movement that aims to stop state-level cooperation with Israeli authorities.

oromo: Duulaan fi namoonni mirga namoomaaf falman biyya Meksikoo keessatti argaman, mootummaan isaanii waliigaltee bulchiinsa bishaanii kan Israa'el wajjin godhate akka addaan kutu gaafachaa jiru. Hiriiftoonni kun waliigalteen kun qabeenya bishaan biyyattii miidhuu akka danda'u yaaddoo ibsuun, mormii kana duula waraana Israa'el kan Gaaza keessatti geggeessaa jirtu waliin wal qabsiisaniiru. Hiriironni bakka gara garaatti geggeeffaman kun, walta'iinsa Israa'el wajjin godhamu hunda dhaabsiisuuf kan gumaachu sochii biyyoolessaa dha.

title: Two Palestinians killed in Israeli strike on Gaza home
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting a residential building in Deir el-Balah, located in central Gaza, has resulted in the deaths of two Palestinians. Emergency services confirmed that the victims were a husband and wife, Kamal Abu Mu’eileq and his spouse. Additionally, several other individuals sustained injuries during the same attack.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ ዲር አል-ባላህ በተባለ አካባቢ በሚገኝ መኖሪያ ቤት ላይ እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የአየር ጥቃት ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እንደገለጹት የሟቾቹ ማንነት ካማል አቡ ሙኢሌቅ እና ባለቤታቸው መሆናቸው ተረጋግጧል። በዚሁ ጥቃት ሌሎች በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Hujjummaan qilleensaa Israa'el ganda Deir el-Balah kan Giza giddu galeessatti argamu keessatti mana jireenyaa tokko irratti raawwatteen namoonni Palestiinaa lama lubbuun darban. Tajaajilli ariifachiisaan akka mirkaneessetti, namoonni miidhaan irra ga'e kun Kamal Abu Mu'eileq fi haadha warraa isaa ti. Hujjumma kana keessatti namoonni biroon hedduun miidhamaniiru.

title: Gaza civil defence teams recover remains of 112 Palestinians from rubble
english: Gaza civil defence teams have retrieved the bodies of 112 Palestinians from beneath the debris in Gaza City’s Sabra neighborhood following a lengthy manual search. The victims included many women, children, and people with disabilities. Rescuers are continuing their difficult efforts, as they estimate that over 150 additional bodies are still trapped under the wreckage.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ የሳብራ ሰፈር ውስጥ የሲቪል መከላከያ ቡድኖች ለቀናት የፈጀ በእጅ የተደረገ ፍለጋ ካደረጉ በኋላ 112 የፍልስጤማውያን አስከሬኖችን ከፍርስራሽ ስር ማውጣት ችለዋል። ከተገኘው አስከሬን መካከል በርካታ ሴቶች፣ ህጻናት እና አካል ጉዳተኞች ይገኙበታል። አሁንም ከ150 በላይ የሚሆኑ ሌሎች አስከሬኖች በፍርስራሹ ስር ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ በመገመት የነፍስ አድን ስራው በከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ቢሆንም መቀጠሉ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Gareen ittisa sivilii Gaaza'aa naannoo Sabraa jedhamutti guyyoota hedduuf harka qullaa erga hojjetanii booda reeffa namoota 112 kan ta'an gamoo diigame jala baasaniiru. Namoota du'an kana keessatti dubartoonni, daa'immanii fi namoonni qaama miidhamtoonni hedduun argamu. Hojjettoonni gargaarsaa haala rakkisaa keessattillee carraaqqii isaanii itti fufaa jiru; ammas reeffa namoota 150 ol ta'antu gamoo diigame sana jala akka jiru tilmaamama.

title: IRGC says three F-35 fighters destroyed at Jordan's Al-Azraq Base
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed responsibility for a ballistic missile strike on the Al-Azraq base in Jordan, stating they destroyed three F-35 fighter jets. Iran described the attack as a retaliation for a previous American strike on Qeshm Island that resulted in civilian casualties. This escalation marks a significant increase in tensions following the deadly incident in July.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ጥበቃ ኃይል በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው አል-አዝራቅ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ በባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎች ጥቃት ሰንዝሬያለሁ ብሏል። በዚህ ጥቃት ሶስት የኤፍ-35 ተዋጊ ጄቶች መውደማቸውን እና ሌሎች ሶስት መጎዳታቸውን ተቋሙ አስታውቋል። ይህ ድርጊት በሐምሌ ወር በቄሽም ደሴት ላይ በአሜሪካ ከተፈጸመው እና የሲቪል ህይወት የቀጠፈው ጥቃት አጸፋ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnoonni Eegumsa Jijjiiramaa Islaamummaa Iraan (IRGC) buufata waraanaa Al-Azraq kan Yordaanos jiru irratti xiyyeeffannoo kutee miisayilaan rukutuun isaa ibsameera. Haleellaa kanaan xiyyaarota waraanaa F-35 sadii manca’uu fi kan biroon sadii immoo miidhamuu isaa eeraniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun haaloo reebicha Ameerikaan ji’a darbe ganda Qeshm irratti raawwatte fi lubbuu namoota nagaa galaafateef deebii kennuuf kan fudhatame ta’uu ibsameera.

title: Young guns for hire - the teenage hitmen recruited to kill across Europe
english: Organized crime groups like Sweden's Foxtrot Network are increasingly recruiting vulnerable teenagers on social media to commit contract killings across Europe. These young people are lured into performing violent tasks through gamified instructions, often resulting in them being caught before they are even paid. Authorities across 11 nations have formed a task force to combat this trend, which includes instances of criminals conducting violent operations on behalf of state actors.
amharic: እንደ ስዊድኑ ፎክስትሮት ኔትወርክ ያሉ የተደራጁ የወንጀል ቡድኖች በአውሮፓ ውስጥ ግድያዎችን ለመፈጸም በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ አማካኝነት ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ታዳጊዎችን በመመልመል ላይ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ወጣቶች በጨዋታ መልክ በተዘጋጁ መመሪያዎች በመታለል ለገንዘብ ሲሉ በግድያ ወንጀል ውስጥ ይሳተፋሉ፤ አብዛኛውን ጊዜም ተልዕኳቸውን ከመጨረሳቸው በፊት በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ይውላሉ። በአውሮፓ ያሉ 11 ሀገራት ይህንን አደገኛ አዝማሚያ ለመግታት በጋራ እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ወንጀለኞቹ አንዳንድ ጊዜ በመንግስት አካላት ስም በሌሎች ሀገራት ግዛቶች ጥቃቶችን ሲፈጽሙ ይስተዋላል።
oromo: gareewwan yakkaa kan akka Foxtrot Network jedhamuu, dargaggoota daa'imman ta'an fayyadamuun Awurooppaatti ajjeechaa raawwachaa jiru. Dargaggoonni kun miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti qacaramaanii, ajaja akka taphaatti itti kennamu hordofuun yakka akka raawwatan ta'u, kunis yeroo baayyee to'annoo jala ooluu isaaniitiin xumurama. Biyyoonni 11 ta'an rakkoo kana to'achuuf wal ta'anii kan hojjechaa jiran yoo ta'u, gareewwan kun yeroo tokko tokko mootummootaafis ta'ee hojii yakkaa adda addaa akka raawwatan himama.

title: The Sopranos star Vincent Pastore dies aged 80
english: Vincent Pastore, best known for his role as Salvatore 'Big Pussy' Bonpensiero in the hit series The Sopranos, has passed away at the age of 80 in New York. Authorities found no signs of foul play at his home in the Bronx. Throughout his long career, he appeared in numerous acclaimed films and television shows, earning praise from colleagues for his talent, generosity, and kindness.
amharic: በታዋቂው የቴሌቪዥን ድራማ 'ዘ ሶፕራኖስ' ሳልቫቶሬ 'ቢግ ፑሲ' ቦንፔንሲዬሮ በመባል የሚታወቀው አሜሪካዊው ተዋናይ ቪንሰንት ፓስቶሬ በ80 ዓመቱ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይቷል። በኒውዮርክ ብሮንክስ በሚገኘው መኖሪያ ቤቱ የተገኘው የሟቹ ህልፈት ወንጀል የተፈጸመበት እንደማይመስል ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል። በረዥም የጥበብ ዘመኑ በተለያዩ ፊልሞች ላይ የተሳተፈው ፓስቶሬ፣ በስራ ባልደረቦቹ ዘንድ ለችሎታውና ለልግስናው ተወዳጅ የነበረ ሰው ነው።
oromo: Aartistii beekamaa fi 'The Sopranos' keessatti gahee 'Big Pussy' taphachaa ture Vinsent Paastooreen waggaa 80tti du'aan boqote. Reeffi isaa mana jireenyaa isaa kan Nyuu Yoorkitti argamu keessatti kan argame yoo ta'u, ajjeechaa ykn shakkii yakkaa tokko illee akka hin jirre ibsameera. Paastooreen hojii isaa keessatti filmiiwwan hedduu irratti kan hirmaate yoo ta'u, hiriyoonni isaa nama kennaa qabu, gaarummaa fi gorsa gaarii namootaaf kennuun kan beekamu akka ture dubbataniiru.

title: Michigan joins Minnesota in reporting cyberattacks, with FBI investigating
english: Michigan and Minnesota are investigating cyberattacks on their water systems, with the FBI now involved in the case. While federal agencies have previously warned about potential Iranian hacking plots against critical infrastructure, no specific culprits have been identified yet. Officials report that despite these digital breaches, water services in both states have continued to operate safely without significant disruptions.
amharic: የሚቺጋን እና የሚኒሶታ ግዛቶች በውኃ አቅርቦት ስርዓታቸው ላይ በደረሰ የሳይበር ጥቃት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ሲሆን የፌዴራል ምርመራ ቢሮ (FBI) ጉዳዩን እየተከታተለ ይገኛል። ቀደም ሲል የኢራን ሃከሮች በዋና ዋና መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ጥቃት ሊሰነዝሩ እንደሚችሉ ማስጠንቀቂያዎች ቢሰጡም፣ አሁን ለደረሰው ጥቃት ተጠያቂ የሆኑ ወገኖች እስካሁን አልታወቁም። ምንም እንኳን የሳይበር ጥቃቱ ቢደርስም፣ በሁለቱም ግዛቶች የውኃ አቅርቦት አገልግሎቶች ያለ ምንም ችግር እየሰሩ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummoonni Michigan fi Minnesota sirna bishaan dhugaatii isaanii irratti weerara sayibarii erga mudatee booda qorannoo eegalaniiru, kunis hirmaannaa FBI tiin gaggeeffamaa jira. Mootummaan biyyoolessaa duraan akka eeggannoo godhan ibsee ture malee, weerara kana eenyutu akka gaggeesse hanga ammaatti hin beekamu. Weerarri kun mudatus, raabsiin bishaanii sadarkaa naannolee lameenitti miidhaa guddaa tokko malee itti fufee akka jiru himameera.

title: US Arabs eye ‘historic’ Senate win for Abdul El-Sayed despite AIPAC attacks
english: Abdul El-Sayed is running for a Michigan Senate seat on a platform that opposes U.S. military support for Israel's current conflicts. Despite facing over $50 million in opposition spending from the pro-Israel lobby group AIPAC, his campaign has become a significant symbol of hope for Arab American communities. Supporters believe a victory would be a historic achievement and a powerful statement against traditional political influence regarding foreign policy.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ በእስራኤል የጦር ግጭቶች ላይ የአሜሪካን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ በመቃወም ለሚቺጋን ሴኔት መቀመጫ እየተወዳደሩ ነው። ምንም እንኳን ከእስራኤል ደጋፊው ኤፓክ (AIPAC) ቡድን ከ50 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የገንዘብ ተቃውሞ ቢገጥማቸውም፣ የዘመቻቸው ውጤት በአረብ አሜሪካውያን ማህበረሰብ ዘንድ ትልቅ ተስፋ ሆኗል። ደጋፊዎቹ የእሳቸው ድል ታሪካዊ ለውጥ እንደሚያመጣ እና በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ የሚደረገውን የተለመደ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ እንደሚገታ ያምናሉ።
oromo: Abdul El-Sayed, gaaffiiwwan waraanaa Israa'el irratti deeggarsa waraana Ameerikaa mormuun teessoo Senaata Miishigan (Michigan) dorgomaa jira. Gareen deggartoota Israa'el kan ta'e AIPAC, baasii doolaara miiliyoona 50 ol ta'uun isaan mormus, duulli isaa hawaasa Arabaa Ameerikaa biratti abdii guddaa ta'eera. Deggartoonni isaa, injifannoon isaa seenaa kan galmeessisuu fi dhiibbaa siyaasaa biyya alaa irratti jijjiirama fiduu danda'a jedhanii amanu.

title: Why did Ceuta migrant mayhem chill already frosty Israel-Spain relations?
english: A massive surge of over 50,000 migrants recently attempted to enter the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, leading to a tragic loss of life and overwhelming local authorities. While some officials point to a recent court ruling regarding migrant returns as a potential trigger, experts remain skeptical about this explanation. The unprecedented scale of the event has raised serious questions about whether the crossing was coordinated and has further strained diplomatic relations.
amharic: ከ50,000 በላይ ስደተኞች በቅርቡ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ በብዛት ለመግባት በመሞከራቸው በርካታ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል የሀገር ውስጥ የጸጥታ አካላትም ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቀው ነበር። ባለስልጣናት ለዚህ ድርጊት መንስኤው በስደተኞች መመለሻ ላይ የወጣው የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ነው ብለው ቢጠረጥሩም ባለሙያዎች ግን ይህን መላምት ይጠራጠራሉ። ይህ ያልተለመደ ክስተት ስደቱ የተቀናጀ መሆን አለመሆኑን በተመለከተ ጥያቄዎችን በማስነሳቱ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነቶች ላይም ጫና ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Godaantonni kuma 50 ol ta'an daangaa magaalaa Se'uutaa kan Ispeen seenuuf yaaluun isaanii lubbuu namaa hedduu kan galaafate yoo ta'u, humnoonni eegumsaas baay'ina isaaniin wal qabatee rakkoo keessa galanii turan. Mootummaan sababa godaantonni kun daangaatti akka goran murteen mana murtii tokko akka ta'e dubbatus, ogeeyyiin garuu yaada kana mormu. Haalli kun karooraan kan raawwatame ta'uu fi dhiisuun isaa shakkii uumuun, walitti dhufeenya diippiloomaasii biyyoota gidduu jiru irrattis dhiibbaa uumeera.

title: Al Jazeera reports from Ceuta as migrants leave the enclave
english: Spanish authorities report that the vast majority of the 60,000 migrants who recently entered the North African enclave of Ceuta have now returned to Morocco on their own. This mass movement followed a sudden surge of people crossing into the territory by both land and sea. Officials indicate that the situation is stabilizing as those individuals have left the area voluntarily.
amharic: በቅርቡ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሱኡታ በየብስ እና በባህር የገቡት ወደ 60,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች በአብዛኛው በፈቃደኝነት ወደ ሞሮኮ መመለሳቸውን የስፔን ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ የሰዎች ፍሰት በድንገት የተከሰተ ቢሆንም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ ተመለሰዋል፡፡ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአካባቢው ያለው ሁኔታ እየተረጋጋ እንደሚገኝም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Hojiin mootummaa Ispeen akka ibsetti, godaantonnii gara 60,000 ta'an kanneen dhiyeenya kana lafa fi galaanaan gara magaalatti Ceuta seenanii turan, hedduun isaanii ofii isaaniitiin gara Marookoo deebi'aniiru. Sosochii namoota hedduu kana booda, haalli naannichaa amma tasgabbaa'aa jiraachuun ibsameera. Namoonni kunneen fedhii isaaniitiin naannichaa gadhiisanii ba'uun isaanii himameera.

title: Iran's Araghchi touts phone calls warning of 'decisive' response to any US aggression
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has communicated with officials from Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia to deliver a stern warning. He stated that Iran is prepared to take firm action against any future acts of aggression from the United States. Through these discussions, he emphasized the country's commitment to defending its borders and national sovereignty.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ከቱርክ፣ ከፓኪስታን እና ከሳዑዲ አረቢያ አቻዎቻቸው ጋር በመነጋገር ጠንካራ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተዋል። አሜሪካ ማንኛውንም አይነት ጥቃት ብትሰነዝር ኢራን ወሳኝ የሆነ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ሚኒስትሩ የሀገሪቱን የግዛት አንድነት እና ሉዓላዊነት ለመጠበቅ ሙሉ ዝግጁነት እንዳላቸው አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchiin, biyyoota akka Turki, Paakistaanii fi Sa'udii Arabiyaa waliin mari'achuun akeekkachiisa cimaa dabarsaniiru. Iraan tarkaanfii kamiyyuu kan Amerikaa irraa ishee mudatuuf deebii murteessaa kennuuf qophii ta'uu ishee ibsaniiru. Kana malees, biyyattiin birmadummaa fi daangaa ishee tiksuuf yeroo hundas qophii ta'uu ministirichi hubachiisaniiru.

title: Iran says Gulf states have a 'moral duty' to block US from using territory
english: Iran has issued a warning to neighboring Gulf countries, urging them to forbid the United States and Israel from launching any military operations against Iranian territory from their bases. Tehran emphasized that these nations have a responsibility to stop such attacks, characterizing recent military actions against them as violations of international law. Iran further stated that it remains fully prepared to defend its sovereignty if its military or infrastructure continues to be targeted.
amharic: ኢራን በባህረ ሰላጤው አካባቢ ለሚገኙ አገራት፣ አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል የኢራንን ግዛት ለማጥቃት የአገራቸውን መሬት ወይም መሠረተ ልማት እንዳይጠቀሙ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥታለች። እነዚህ አገራት ጥቃቱን የመከላከል ሞራላዊ እና ህጋዊ ኃላፊነት እንዳለባቸው የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ገልጿል። ኢራን አክላም፣ የራሷን ሉዓላዊነት እና የጦር ኃይል ለመከላከል አስፈላጊውን ሁሉ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Iraan biyyoota naannoo Ganna garbaatti argamanitti akeekkachiisa laatteetti; kunis Ameerikaan ykn Israa'el biyyoota kana keessatti buufataalee isaanii fayyadamanii lola Iraan irratti akka hin banne dha. Mootummoonni naannichaa weerara akkanaa ittisuuf dirqama seeraa fi amallummaa akka qaban ministeerri dhimma alaa Iraan ibseera. Iraan, yoo buufataalee fi meeshaalee ishee irratti haleellaan itti fufe, aangoo of ittisuu guutuu akka qabdu fi tarkaanfii akka fudhattu hubachiisteetti.

title: Palestinian children among those detained in Israeli West Bank raids
english: Israeli military forces conducted a series of raids across the occupied West Bank this Saturday, resulting in the arrests of several people. Among those taken into custody were two teenagers, both 16 years old, from the towns of Tubas and Wadi Fukin. In addition to these minors, reports indicate that multiple adults were also detained during the operation.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ቅዳሜ ዕለት በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት ዘመቻ በርካታ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ከተያዙት መካከል በቱባስ እና በዋዲ ፉኪን ከተሞች የሚኖሩ ሁለት የ16 ዓመት ታዳጊዎች ይገኙበታል። ከታዳጊዎቹ በተጨማሪ በርካታ አዋቂዎችም በዚሁ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን ወቅት መታሰራቸው ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnooni waraana Israa'el Dilbata kana godina West Bank keessatti duula gaggeessaniin namoota hedduu qabanii jiru. Namoota qabaman kana keessatti dargaggoonni umuriin isaanii waggaa 16 ta'e lama magaala Tubas fi Wadi Fukin keessatti argamu. Dabalataanis, duula kanaan namoonni ga'eessota ta'an hedduuns akka hidhaman gabaafameera.

title: EU calls emergency meeting to discuss Ceuta migrant crossings
english: The European Union is convening an emergency meeting to address the recent surge of thousands of migrants crossing into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco. While most migrants have since returned, the event has sparked significant political tension, with several EU member states questioning Spain's border management and calling for stronger external controls. Spanish officials have defended their actions, arguing that their borders are secure and criticizing other nations for using the situation to stir political polarization.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሴኡታ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች መግባታቸውን ተከትሎ በአስቸኳይ የሚወያዩበት ስብሰባ ጠርቷል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኛዎቹ ስደተኞች ወደ ሀገራቸው የተመለሱ ቢሆንም፣ ክስተቱ በአውሮፓ ህብረት አባል ሀገራት መካከል ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውዝግብ አስነሳል። የስፔን መንግስት ድንበሩን በአግባቡ መቆጣጠሩን በመግለጽ፣ ሌሎች ሀገራት ሁኔታውን ለፖለቲካ ፍጆታ መዋልን በመቃወም እየተከራከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa baqattoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman biyya Morookoo irraa gara daangaa Sipeen kan taate Se'uutaa seenuu isaanii hordofee walgahii hatattamaa waameera. Baqattoonni hedduun booda deebi'anii jiranis, taateen kun biyyoota miseensa Gamtaa Awurooppaa gidduutti wal dhabdee siyaasaa uumeera. Mootummaan Sipeen daangaa isaa guututti to'achuu isaa ibsuun, biyyoonni biraa rakkoo kanaaf akka meeshaa siyaasaatti fayyadamaa jiran komateera.

title: Police say 13 killed as small plane viewing Nazca Lines in Peru crashes
english: A small sightseeing plane crashed in southern Peru, resulting in the deaths of all 13 people on board. The flight was carrying tourists to view the historic Nazca Lines, a famous UNESCO World Heritage site known for its ancient ground carvings. The aircraft caught fire immediately upon impact, and authorities are currently investigating the cause of the fatal accident.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ፔሩ የቱሪስት አውሮፕላን ተከስክሶ በውስጡ የነበሩ 13 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አውሮፕላኑ ታዋቂውን የናዝካ መስመሮች (Nazca Lines) ለመጎብኘት በረራ ላይ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ከተከሰከሰ በኋላ በአደጋው ሁሉም ተሳፋሪዎችና የአውሮፕላኑ አብራሪዎች ሞተዋል። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው የተከሰተውን የእሳት ቃጠሎ ተከትሎ የደረሰውን አሳዛኝ ክስተት መንስኤ እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Xiyyaarri xiqqoon tuuristoota fe’ee ture kibba Peruutti kufuusaa, namoonni 13 battalatti lubbuun darbe. Xiyyaarichi bakka seena-qabeessa kan ta’e 'Nazca Lines' ilaaluuf erga ka’ee booda dha, erga kufuusaa boodas ibiddaan guutamee lubbuun nama tokkoo illee hin oolle. Aangoonni mootummaa sababa balaa kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Fighting breaks out in western Tigray as Ethiopia and TPLF trade blame
english: Violent clashes have erupted in western Tigray, marking a major violation of the 2022 peace agreement between the Ethiopian federal government and Tigrayan forces. Both sides have traded accusations over who initiated the fighting near Sheraro, which follows months of rising tensions and failed negotiations. Experts warn this is the most significant threat to peace since the Pretoria deal, as both parties claim the other is responsible for the instability.
amharic: በኢትዮጵያ ፌዴራላዊ መንግሥት እና በትግራይ ኃይሎች መካከል የተደረሰው የሰላም ስምምነት በመጣስ በምዕራብ ትግራይ አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ግጭት ተቀስቅሷል። በሸራሮ አቅራቢያ በተካሄደው ውጊያ ላይ ሁለቱም ወገኖች የጥቃቱ መነሻ ሌላኛው ወገን ነው በሚል እርስ በርስ እየተወነጃጀሉ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ክስተት ከወራት በፊት ሲባባስ የቆየውን ውጥረት ተከትሎ የመጣ ሲሆን፣ እ.ኤ.አ በ2022 የተፈረመውን የፕሪቶሪያ የሰላም ስምምነት ለአደጋ የጋለጠ ትልቅ ስጋት መሆኑን ታዛቢዎች ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa federaalaafi humnoota Tigraay gidduutti walii galteen nagaa bara 2022 irra darbuun, lixaa Tigraay keessatti walitti bu’iinsi cimaan uumameera. Gamachuun kunneen naannoo Sharaarootti kan jalqabaman yoo ta’u, gama lamaanuu lola kana eenyutu akka jalqabe wal himataa jiru. Walitti bu’iinsi kun ji’oota hedduuf dhiphinaafi walitti bu’iinsa siyaasaa ture hordofuun kan dhufe yoo ta’u, ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, kun walii galtee nagaa Preetooriyaa booda balaa nagaa biyyattii irratti xuuxu hunda caaluudha.

title: Tourist plane crashes in Peru, killing 13
english: A small tourist plane crashed near the Nazca Lines in Peru on Saturday, resulting in the deaths of all 13 people on board. The flight included 11 passengers and two pilots who were touring the famous UNESCO World Heritage site. Authorities are currently investigating the incident, as the specific cause of the accident and the identities of those involved remain unknown.
amharic: በፔሩ ናዝካ መስመሮች አቅራቢያ በተከሰተ የአውሮፕላን አደጋ በውስጡ የነበሩት 13 ሰዎች በሙሉ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አውሮፕላኑ 11 መንገደኞችን እና ሁለት አብራሪዎችን አሳፍሮ ታዋቂውን የቱሪስት መዳረሻ ሲጎበኝ ነበር የደረሰው። ባለሥልጣናቱ የአደጋውን መንስኤ እና የተጎጂዎቹን ማንነት ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo biyya Peru kan argamu bakka seena-qabeessa 'Nazca Lines' jedhamutti xiyyaaraan xiqqa tokko kan krashe yoo ta'u, namoonni 13 keessa turan hundi du'aniiru. Xiyyaarrichi namoota 11 fi qondaaltota 2 fe'ee bakka kana daawwachaa ture. Aangeyyoonni sababa balaa kanaa fi eenyummaa namoota du'anii qorachaa jiru.

title: Greece battles raging wildfires as flames appear to ease in France
english: Greece is currently facing severe wildfires fueled by high winds, leading to widespread evacuations and the destruction of homes near Athens. Emergency crews are working extensively to manage the growing disaster as authorities warn of continued extreme risks. Meanwhile, officials in France report that their own major forest fires have finally been brought under control following successful containment efforts.
amharic: ግሪክ በኃይለኛ ንፋስ በተባባሱ ሰደድ እሳቶች እየተጠቃች ሲሆን፣ በኤቴንስ አካባቢ ነዋሪዎች እንዲፈናቀሉና ቤቶች እንዲወድሙ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ባለስልጣናት ከፍተኛ ስጋት እንዳለ እያስጠነቀቁ በአካባቢው የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለመቆጣጠር ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። በሌላ በኩል የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት በሀገሪቱ ተከስተው የነበሩት አደገኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎዎች በአሁኑ ወቅት ቁጥጥር ስር መዋላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Giriikiin sababa bubbee cimaan ibiddi bosonaa babal’achaa jiraachuun, namoonni bakka jireenyaa isaanii akka gadhiisan dirqisiiseera akkasumas mannooni hedduun barbadaa’aniiru. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa fi humnoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa ibidda kana dhaamsuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Gama biraatiin, biyyi Faransaay ibiddi bosonaa biyyattii keessatti ka’ee ture amma to’annoo jala ooluu isaa ibsiteetti.

title: Record-breaking climber Nirmal Purja among those killed in avalanche
english: Renowned Nepalese mountaineer Nirmal Purja, famous for his record-breaking climbs featured in a Netflix documentary, has died in an avalanche. The tragedy occurred during his expedition at Broad Peak in Pakistan. Rescue teams have already recovered three bodies from the site.
amharic: በኔትፍሊክስ ዘጋቢ ፊልም የታወቁት እና የዓለማችንን ከፍተኛ ተራሮች በመውጣት ሪከርድ የሰበሩት የኔፓላዊው ተራራ ተወጣጣ ኒርማል ፑርጃ በአደጋ ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በፓኪስታን በሚገኘው ብሮድ ፒክ ተራራ ላይ በደረሰ የበረዶ ናዳ ምክንያት ነው አደጋው የተከሰተው። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች እስካሁን የሶስት ሰዎችን አስከሬን ማግኘታቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Namni gaara bahuun beekamu fi dokumantarii Neetfliks irraa beekamtii argate Nirmal Purja, balaa gaara irraa gadi dhufte kanaan lubbuun isaa darbeera. Balaan kun kan isa mudate yeroo inni biyya Paakistaanitti gaara 'Broad Peak' bahuuf yaalii gochaa turetti. Gareen fayyisuu namoota sadanii reeffa erga arganii booda du'a isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Trump denounces Justice Department decision to drop Reflecting Pool charges
english: President Donald Trump has publicly criticized the Department of Justice for dropping vandalism charges against former athlete David Hearn regarding damage to the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. While prosecutor Jeanine Pirro concluded the damage was due to a botched installation rather than intentional destruction, Trump insists the incident was an act of vandalism. This controversy highlights ongoing tensions surrounding the pool's renovation, which has faced scrutiny due to the president's decision to bypass competitive bidding for the project.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር በሊንከን ሜሞሪያል የመዋኛ ገንዳ ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት በማስመልከት በቀድሞ አትሌት ዳዊት ሄርን ላይ መስርቶት የነበረውን ክስ መዝጋቱን ተችተዋል። አቃቤ ህጉ ጉዳቱ የደረሰው በስህተት በተሰራ ግንባታ እንጂ በሆን ተብሎ በተፈጸመ ጥፋት አይደለም ብለው ቢደመድሙም፣ ትራምፕ ግን ድርጊቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈጸመ የጥፋት ወንጀል መሆኑን አጥብቀው ይከራከራሉ። ይህ ክስተት የመዋኛ ገንዳውን እድሳት ለማከናወን በጨረታ ሂደት ውስጥ የተመረጠው ኩባንያ አሰራር ላይ እየተነሳ ያለውን ተቃውሞ ይበልጥ ጎላ አድርጎ አሳይቷል።

title: Palestinian children among those detained in Israeli West Bank raids
english: Israeli forces recently detained seven Palestinians, including two teenagers, during a series of overnight military raids across various locations in the occupied West Bank. Simultaneously, there has been a rise in settler violence, highlighted by an attack on a farming couple and the establishment of multiple illegal outposts. These incidents are part of a broader, ongoing trend of daily military operations and settlement expansion affecting communities throughout the region.

title: At least three killed in explosion near cafe in Russia’s Moscow
english: An explosion occurred near a cafe in Moscow's Kudrinskaya Square on Saturday evening, resulting in at least three deaths and 15 injuries. Emergency services have been deployed to the scene to assist the wounded, and surrounding traffic and metro entrances have been closed. Local authorities are currently investigating the cause of the blast.

oromo: Dilbata galgala magaalaa Moskoo bakka Kudrinskaya Square jedhamuutti, nyaataaf dhugaatii keessatti kan hundaa'e bakka tokko biratti dhuka'iinsa mudateen lubbuun namoota saddeetiif sadii darbeera; namoonni 15 ammoo miidhamaniiru. title: Seven killed by Israeli strikes today: Gaza civil defence agency
english: The Palestinian Civil Defence agency reports that at least seven people have been killed in Gaza following Israeli strikes today. Among the victims were two individuals struck by a drone while on a rooftop in Gaza City. This violence follows Hamas's recent acceptance of a new ceasefire proposal drafted by the United States.

oromo: Hojii gaggeessitoonni ittisa sivilii Falasxiin akka ibsanitti, guyyaa har'aa haleellaa Israa'el iddoowwan adda addaatti geggeessiteen namoonni gara torba ta'an du'aniiru. title: Evening recap
english: Tensions are rising across the Middle East as US embassies warn citizens to leave the region due to fears of escalation between the US and Iran. Violent incidents continue with drone strikes in Kuwait, Israeli military actions in Gaza and Lebanon, and ongoing instability in the West Bank. Meanwhile, the UK government is considering stricter measures against Israeli settlers, while the Houthis have dismissed claims that they are charging fees for ship passage.

title: Italy putting nearly all major cities on highest heat alert
english: Italy has placed almost all its major cities on the highest heat alert as a powerful heatwave sweeps across the country. Authorities warn that the extreme temperatures pose a serious health risk to everyone, not just vulnerable groups, and advise staying indoors during peak heat. This intense weather is caused by a subtropical anticyclone from North Africa, which is also contributing to dangerous wildfire conditions throughout Europe.

title: ‘Marathon’ shines light on Gaza’s orphaned children and humanitarian crisis
english: In Khan Younis, Gaza, children held a symbolic marathon to draw global attention to the severe humanitarian crisis and the tens of thousands of orphans created by the ongoing conflict. With over 58,000 children having lost one or both parents, the event highlighted the urgent need for psychosocial support and protection for those suffering from the war's devastating effects. The race served as a platform for families to share their experiences of loss and displacement while advocating for greater assistance for Gaza’s vulnerable youth.
amharic: በጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ ከተማ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ወላጆቻቸውን ላጡ ህጻናት የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ትኩረት ለመስጠት ተምሳሌታዊ የሩጫ ውድድር ተካሂዷል። ከ58,000 በላይ ህጻናት ወላጆቻቸውን ባጡበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ ይህ ዝግጅት ለተጎጂዎች አስቸኳይ የስነ-ልቦና ድጋፍ እና ጥበቃ እንደሚያስፈልግ ለማሳሰብ ያለመ ነው። ዝግጅቱ ህጻናት እና ቤተሰቦቻቸው በጦርነቱ የደረሰባቸውን መከራ እንዲገልጹ እድል የሰጠ ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንዲደረግላቸው ጥሪ አቅርቧል።

Ijoolleen 58,000 ol ta’an waraana kana keessatti warra isaanii dhabuun isaanii kan ibsame yoo ta’u, ijoollee kanneeniif deeggarsi sammuu fi nageenyaa yeroodhaan akka barbaachisu dhaamsa dabarseera. title: Trump pledges to pursue ‘anti-weaponisation’ fund amid Blanche standoff
english: President Trump has threatened to revive a controversial taxpayer-funded program if the Senate does not confirm his attorney general nominee, Todd Blanche. Some Republican senators are currently blocking Blanche’s appointment due to concerns that the fund would be used to reward political allies. Trump suggested he might bypass the confirmation process and continue keeping Blanche in the role as acting attorney general.
